claims: Chuck Norris had an estimated net worth of $70 million at the time of his passing in March 2026.
Chuck Norris amassed his fortune over a five-decade career that spanned martial arts, film, television, and various business ventures.
Chuck Norris had a long-running role on Walker, Texas Ranger from 1993 to 2001.
Chuck Norris appeared in films such as Missing in Action and The Delta Force.
Chuck Norris filed a $30 million lawsuit against CBS and Sony in 2018 for unpaid royalties related to Walker, Texas Ranger streaming.
Chuck Norris was a long-running pitchman for Total Gym equipment.
Chuck Norris built a business empire that included his own martial arts system Chun Kuk Do and real estate investments.
Chuck Norris passed away on March 20, 2026, at the age of 86.
